notes.title: Clarity of Life - Final Notice V053
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]This update is the last one I'll be doing til late September - I'm going on a honeymoon trip so I'll be away for some time. When I get back though, there'll be quite a lot of work to do, cause next fest will be right around the corner (AAAAAAAAA).[/p][p][/p][h1]Combat Log[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/69233f347415380e52566bc16362cd555cc5d1c7.png"][/img][/p][p]You may notice the insanely obvious new rectangle above your cards - this is the combat log![/p][p]It's functionally working now, if a bit untidy, but this new combat log should make it so that you can more easily keep track of the game as it progresses, and scroll back through something if you weren't sure what happened. Now you might also think to yourself "all well and good, but what about the boss cards? 'Set Aflame' doesn't tell me what the boss card did. [/p][p]WELL, ACTUALLY ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/7e61ba16d0629a40177479532e6cbcbcd514b83b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hovering over the boss' card play actions gives you this popup, and clicking it:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/fdd8b91967e302555317f01f2eb120c24e4dcfe1.png"][/img][/p][p]Lets you reread the card![/p][p][/p][p]This is a pretty big QoL change and took up the majority of the recent development time, since I've basically done away with the old popup system. Let me know what you think - this update was actually out a week earlier (and worked on while being) in the discord's playtest group. If you want access:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/1275ef22caae42564ee57ca5cdaf87a3dfb039b2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That's all I've got, a nice major system change for better QoL. I'll be back from holiday around the 22nd, where I'll jump back into my full time job and hopefully back into a series of updates for Final Notice, ready for next fest.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: The Ferryman - Final Notice V0.5.2
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Today's update includes a new boss, Charon, some added passives and an increased bucket selection for the roguelike mode. This one took a little longer - working on changing the popup system to instead be a chat box that lets you scroll through events, so you've got a history of what's gone on without having to stare at the screen and catch every popup. Next update won't feature a boss due to that - it'll be that upgrade. Stay tuned for that.[/p][p][/p][h2]Charon, The Ferryman[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/d02594137355040bf9bd9d02305d25bd49dc798b.png"][/img][/p][p]Ferryman of the underworld, Charon's primary mechanic revolves around him shuffling 15 obols, the currency used to pay the ferryman, into your deck. Charon initially starts out quite strong and is a T2 difficulty boss, but the more obols you play the easier he becomes. Manage to find (or duplicate enough obols) to play 15 of them, and you automatically win the game.[/p][p][/p][p]He only plays a single card per turn, save for one card he has that allows him to play 3 for that turn alone, so you don't often have to worry about him chaining off several strong effects, but the cards he has are particularly dangerous if you don't find the obols. Make sure you've got a little card draw, and if you're in the roguelike mode, pray you found a little card draw lmao.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Passives[/h2][list][*][p]Divinity Toxin: [i]If you end your turn with a full hand, the boss gains 5 mortis.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Death's Calendar: [i]When you play your 60th card, win the game.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Smoke Break: [i]At the end of your turns, if you have 50+ mortis, lose 5 mortis.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]The Button: [i]The first time your hand is empty, stun the boss.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Mortis Rebate: [i]After you play a card, lose 2 mortis. (Note - this will NOT prevent you from death by playing a card that would take you to 100 mortis.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Barghest Improvements[/h3][p]The Barghest boss lacked a few QOL features like a howl counter on the background and, I don't know if anyone else did, but I found the background too bright at times, and sort of annoying, so both have been mended.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bucket Expansion[/h3][p]More buckets have been added to the roguelike mode, to further diversify what you might be able to build in the roguelike mode. Do report any issues![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/1275ef22caae42564ee57ca5cdaf87a3dfb039b2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Black Dog - Final Notice V0.5.1
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back[/h1][p]Today's additions sees a small change to the roguelike mode, a new difficulty 1 boss and, finally, a new card.[/p][p][/p][h2]Roguelike Change:[/h2][p]While difficulty one bosses are doable with the preset decks, it felt a bit bad losing your first game, so I yoinked a playtester, PaxGladeus', idea and implemented the first fight as one of the randomised bosses from the usual mode. Should hopefully mean you can get into the actual roguelike-ing a bit quicker.[/p][p][/p][h1]The Barghest[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/80c2e2790ae2ae45573fdf4f55934f9d1fa9d91c.png"][/img][/p][p]The Black Dog of the Yorkshire Moors, the Barghest's primary mechanic is centred around his howl, in myth an omen of death to those that see the dog stalking the countryside.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Howl[/h3][p]When the Barghest howls, the rest of their cards will improve. They will howl once per turn, using a card to do so, meaning this boss will always play a howl, then one other card per turn. This does mean the boss will do less on it's turns than usual, but if you do not put the dog down quickly, you might find yourself feeling like it's doing quite a lot more.[/p][p][/p][h2]Howling Echo - New Card![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/13a596c00eebcce5c6131d79c6afc88cc9076619.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Howling Echo [/i]is a card suggested by PaxGladeus, a playtester, and it essentially just triggers all hold effects of the cards in your hand. I had considered making this banish on play, but I quite like the idea of it being a centrepiece with a complicated recursion combo, so I kept it. Give it a shot after beating the Barghest.[/p][p][/p][p]With that, we conclude the update notes for 0.5.1 - hope you enjoy the update[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time- where the ferryman waits.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/d02594137355040bf9bd9d02305d25bd49dc798b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/1275ef22caae42564ee57ca5cdaf87a3dfb039b2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: V0.5.0 Roguelike Mode Release
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Finally, the main part of the game. Final Notice now has a functioning (albeit a little lean) roguelike mode. Let's talk about expectations, both with the new mode and the future, and what the upcoming plan is.[/p][p][/p][h1]Roguelike Mode: How does it work?[/h1][p]I mentioned how the general cycle goes in the beta announcement from a couple of days ago, so I'll repost that:[/p][olist][*][p]Start a new run, picking a smaller-than-usual preset deck based on their normal preset counterparts[/p][/*][*][p]Fight the first boss, a difficulty 1 boss and, hopefully, win![/p][/*][*][p]Choose from 3 different sets of 5 cards to add to your deck[/p][/*][*][p]Choose from 2 different passives to add to your run[/p][/*][*][p]Face a boss from the difficulty up[/p][/*][*][p]Repeat this until you lose.[/p][/*][/olist][p]The number of passives, bosses and card selections you get will of course increase with time, right now we've just got the 11 bosses from the bounty mode and around 12 passives that you can end up with. There isn't a limit to the mode, so you can go until you lose, but naturally you're probably going to run into the same bosses fairly frequently. Because of that, the primary focus for the game, at least for a while, will be new bosses, passives and cards for the card pools.[/p][p]Speaking of...[/p][p][/p][h2]New Boss: Prometheus[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/468827055c311d3132a6f10ed7f203ef2713b444.png"][/img][/p][p]Prometheus is our newest boss, a difficulty 1 boss, who's primary game revolves around his addition of the card "Kindling" into your hand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/ecc9f35d915e5b94c3e074d5a1542efb78f16a29.png"][/img][/p][p]The concept for Kindling was, from my own playtesting, that it felt pretty good to get something out of cards like these, to use them as fuel for "select a card to banish" type cards or as card draw, but it's obviously not supposed to be completely free. Kindling is always burning when it hits your hand too, so there's some synergy there with cleanse cards that provide extra effects.[/p][p]Other than that, Prometheus, being a titan, hits quite hard in general, and that only increases as you use his Kindling, so be careful on your usage. He doesn't utterly flood your hand with the card the same as Kalfu or the other Voodoo bosses tend to, so don't worry too much about having to keep cards around that clear hand space.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Future[/h2][p]I mentioned it a little above, but I'll be primarily working on bosses from here on out, then passives, then card pools. Ideally I'd like every roguelike run to feel different, but to do that it's going to require a lot of content. Right now they're pretty individual, I think you can get a solid few hours out of the runs before they get a little samey, but you tell me. Best place to do that, and to keep up to date with the game is, of course, by joining the discord. [/p][p]You can scroll to the bottom of the page to find the link, looks like a little discord icon.[/p][p]With all that said-[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time, and[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ROGUELIKE BETA IS NOW! - V0.5.0 Beta
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]After quite a while of talking about it and a whole lot of work, the roguelike beta is now live on the playtesting branch. If you want to be a part of it, join the discord [url="https://discord.gg/kvHHgARtFp"]here[/url] to get the access details, or if you have me added somewhere just message me and ask.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/d40b2d7d717bba3b9ea8b442d017000ee905dfd4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]What To Expect[/h1][p]Currently the roguelike beta runs off a very simple loop:[/p][olist][*][p]Start a new run, picking a smaller-than-usual preset deck based on their normal preset counterparts[/p][/*][*][p]Fight the first boss, a difficulty 1 boss and, hopefully, win![/p][/*][*][p]Choose from 3 different sets of 5 cards to add to your deck[/p][/*][*][p]Choose from 2 different passives to add to your run[/p][/*][*][p]Face a boss from the difficulty up[/p][/*][*][p]Repeat this until you lose.[/p][/*][/olist][p]When losing, you'll be sent to an "in-progress" stats screen, that will show you how many bosses you beat, cards you had, and so on - current plan is to reward particularly long streaks or total win numbers with cards, but none are implemented just yet, hence the beta. This beta's really more about balancing this and ironing out bugs, as right now I expect this to be a little too hard.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/baad4e0ac13372308115322ce1c12372215eb559.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Saving Your Run[/h1][p]Yes, you can save your run, you do not have to beat your run in one sitting and you can exit the game, or use other modes within the game perfectly fine without ruining your run (i think. Do not quote me on that. Please tell me if this doesn't work or if there's bugs with this lmfao).[/p][p]When exiting, you'll be sent back to the last time you won a match and had not yet made any choices.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/24996a71168ea55967485834902e1f87061de3be.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]"Doesn't that mean I can just reroll my boss/rewards?"[/h3][p]Yes. I don't care, it's your game, cheat if you want, it's a single player game lmao.[/p][p][/p][p]This is the last big mode to be added, from here on out, it's cards, passives, more card buckets, more bosses, nice little additions like cosmetics and, of course, fixes, balance and visual upgrades. My thanks to everyone that's been sticking with me through this project and of course those that have played the game and wishlisted it - to reiterate my plans, once the game is completely complete in terms of having a satisfactory amount of bosses, passives, card base, unlockable cards and so on, the game will move to either being in Early Access or the full release, depending on how much more there is to add. If it's Early Access chances are it won't be in there long unless a lot more work needs doing or I decide to move to EA earlier than what I currently plan. Either way, all I've got for you all today, as always-[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time... and-[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/1275ef22caae42564ee57ca5cdaf87a3dfb039b2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Roguelike Mode Coming Soon - V0.4.9
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Today's update isn't very big, it's pretty much just a "sort stuff out" update before 0.5.0, the big introduction of the roguelike mode! There's going to have to be a lot of testing and balancing on that, so for the sake of making sure that the mode comes out properly, I'm giving the password for the beta for it out in the discord - if you wanna try the mode out, either message me if you have me somewhere or join the discord for the update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why tho[/h2][p]Mainly because I need the feedback - if anything breaks or goes wrong works not quite as intended, I won't know if I'm not told. It's an entire new mode and it's the last sort of "part" to what Final Notice is going to be, gameplay wise, so it's important I get this working properly and squash any bugs, hammer out anything that's way overtuned and pump up anything that's lacking.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/1275ef22caae42564ee57ca5cdaf87a3dfb039b2.png"][/img][/p][p]There's a link at the bottom of this page with the discord - join that, when the beta is ready I'll announce it and give the password to the beta.[/p][p][/p][p]Now on to the actual update, pretty small one, couple new cards and a new look, which some of you may have already noticed![/p][p][/p][h1]Visual Change[/h1][p]Backgrounds in the main menu, index, deck select and bounty areas has been changed to something a bit more fancy. Do let me know what you think, as this will be the primary style for the backgrounds going forward unless general consensus is it sucks (ːsteamsadː)[/p][p][/p][h1]New Cards[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/efd2a4f520ce2a4239594d653ec2f9c2d8c0f3e6.png"][/img][/p][p]Two new cards have been added![/p][p][/p][h3]Tax Evasion[/h3][p][i]Intended to give more options to decks that look to OTK without making them meta, Tax Evasion is made for that one turn where you really combo off. It's especially handy with the ever-loved Frenzy Protocol and Soul Chain bombo.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Hidden Ace[/h3][p][i]To further the mechanics from previous inclusions, Hidden Ace is made as a minor helper to keep your hand stocked at the cost of a hand slot while held, and actively increases your hand size when played for a fair cost. Be sure not to hold it for too long![/i][/p][p][/p][p]That concludes V0.4.9 - again, if you're interested in the roguelike mode, it'll be in beta next week. Look forward to it, I think it's probably the most important addition Final Notice will receive.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: The Queen of Yomi - Final Notice V0.4.8
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Today's update is a bit earlier than usual, because I'll be preoccupied for next week, which means I might not be around to drop an 0.4.9 update. Got some home renovation in the works, pain in the ass. In compensation, we've got 0.4.8, featuring a difficult new boss to fill out the roster and a new card for beating them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/f297b6c56addf90a769d53b6d83a14d16da02d3d.png"][/img][/p][h1]Izanami, Yomibound[/h1][p]Izanami's our second tier 5 addition, and features a playstyle switch early in the fight, swapping from being defensive and controlling, to high aggression and burn once you get her past a certain mortis value. Make sure you take a look at the tips - it mentions a very important side point - codexes don't work in this fight![/p][p]I wanted to make this fight very thematic, so I've done quite a lot of work on presentation for this fight, even featuring a custom track for Izanami as well as being the first boss to feature a "mode switch" and a brand new mechanic that'll be expanded upon with more cards as time goes on. [/p][p]Izanami will be able to alter the maximum hand size of the reaper, resulting in card draw being overall less effective, due to limited hand space. As usual, "adding" cards to your hand ignores the hand max, so you may want to leverage that.[/p][p]The reward for beating her allows you to take the hand size adjustment present in this fight in your favour, and start really scaling out on just how much you can hold. Be careful you don't end up holding too much![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/8069161099136896642b36a4d65b1c7c141eb923.png"][/img][/p][p]I should thank a friend for suggesting this mechanic, it's neat and I've got quite a lot of ideas of how to expand upon it, even possibly leveraging cards that have extra mechanics based on lowering your hand limit in trade for highly positive effects. You'll have to wait and see![/p][p][/p][h2]Discord Opened![/h2][p]You'll find a new link in the game's main screen that takes you to the discord, it'll be essentially empty for a while I imagine, but if you've anything you'd like to ask me, it's there. I've had a few DMs here and there about the game and, while I don't mind that, I've also added a fair number of people that've essentially just said "hey man wanna give me 200 dollars and i'll run away with it- i mean make u art bro".[/p][p]Also I made a banner so I'm damn well using it here.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/1275ef22caae42564ee57ca5cdaf87a3dfb039b2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: The Gorgon - Final Notice V0.4.6
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]So I recognise this is a short time since the last devlog, which was literally yesterday, but I've realised I'm not going to have time later this week to work on the game due to home renovation, so I cranked out what was going to be the midweek update today.[/p][p]Not a huge update, mind, but it does feature:[/p][p][/p][h1]Medusa, The Gorgon[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/8a2643ec7e3616a348eac757c0f30ef912b8d0f8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you've read the past update, you'll recognise this, but I figured I'll probably just explain what the "final concept" of Medusa ended out being. Medusa will play a lot of cards, she'll regularly play cards that increase the player's mortis over time, while also allowing her to play additional cards each turn. Naturally, she also "entombs" your cards, turning them to stone and rendering them unplayable, but still discardable.[/p][p][/p][p]Consequently, it's very easy to get into a position where Medusa is able to play 5 cards a turn, stacking her over time effects and entombing your hand, leading to a slow control-through-playrate style of play. This is also the first boss who's boss unlock actually features as a part of the boss battle, as you get 5 "mirror shards" shuffled into your deck at the start of the battle.[/p][p][/p][h2]Mirror Shard[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/6f36efadaa530a51746f7e4cdbf6a26be03f9983.png"][/img][/p][p]As might be obvious, Mirror Shard, Medusa's unlock for beating her, is specifically good against her, but is also just a 0 cost cleanse. Naturally any other bosses that end up using entomb may see you playing this when you build your deck against them.[/p][p][/p][h2]Balance and Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]R34P now only burns your leftmost card in hand, instead of your whole hand, when it fires.[/p][/*][*][p]E.O.D. now can not discard itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Some boss cards weren't unlocking - fixed that! If you've beat any bosses but didn't get a card from them, check your card index, they should unlock automatically when you check it.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how card fetching works "behind the scenes" to allow cards that are not unlocked to be inserted into decks.[/p][/*][*][p]Edit: Forgot to add - Dreams Domain got nerfed! You should find the veil mechanic far less frustrating. Considering changing the effect to be less subtle too, but that isn't in this update so far.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: From CCG To Roguelike: Making Final Notice's New Mode
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Welcome or Welcome Back![/b][/h1][hr][/hr][p]In today's devlog, I'll be speaking a little about the work done thus far on the roguelike mode, going over what's going to be included in the 0.5.0 update, and what you can expect from the updates between 0.4.5 and then.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Expectations:[/b][/h2][p]For updates between 0.4.5, they'll generally come weekly (give or take a few days) and include content that will be featured in the roguelike mode, but isn't made specifically for it. This can be:[/p][list][*][p]New bosses[/p][/*][*][p]New cards[/p][/*][*][p]New [i]unlockable cards[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Balance changes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes (obviously!)[/p][/*][/list][p]The roguelike systems are being created to be heavily built off of the main game, with the idea that each addition to the main game is an addition to the roguelike mode, so that any addition to the game has some worth, regardless of what mode you prefer to play in. For 0.4.6, I've already made a few balance changes, namely to R34P and E.O.D. per some recent feedback, as well as improved the look of the Entombed status effect from the placeholder to an actual "stone" look, in accordance with the introduction of a new boss...[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Medusa, The Gorgon[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/8a2643ec7e3616a348eac757c0f30ef912b8d0f8.png"][/img][/p][p]Yeppers, the update will drop when Medusa is ready, and will be filling our spot for a tier 2 difficulty boss, along with the only other one right now, Zeus. Her main mechanic will revolve around causing your cards to become entombed, completely unplayable by normal means, but can still be discarded. You'll need to pack a way to remove the effect, a way to cheat the effect out or cards that don't particularly care about being played, like Contemplate... from Thoth's reward or like R34P, which ups mortis for the boss without needing to be played.[/p][p]As a thematic part of her legend, the player will have 5 instances of "Mirror Shard" shuffled into their deck at the beginning of the match - a card that will increase Medusa - or any boss' mortis - based on the number of Entombed cards in your hand, then cleanse the effects. [i](Still workshopping this, so this might change, but that's what I've got for now!).[/i][/p][p]There will of course be more bosses as the weeks go on, but this is just the first of a few. Unlike last time, these bosses won't be pantheon-thematic, so don't expect the next 4 bosses to all be Greek.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Roguelike Progress[/b][/h1][p]What might be the more interesting news here - the base systems for the roguelike mode are entirely complete, some bits still need visually sprucing up, as do the "inbetween matches" screen, the case for the reaper on a loss needs swapping up from the usual ability to retry to a restart run and I've gotta save your current run to a json so you don't have to play till you lose and can come back whenever you like, but the actual:
Start run -> Win first match -> choose bucket from 3 options -> choose passive -> go next is in there.[/p][p]Right now the bosses are always just T1 bosses, e.g. Kalfu or Marinette, but that's because I don't actually have enough bosses to fill out a proper choice system right now, hence Medusa's inclusion first. You might be able to work out, if you've took a look at the current tiers, that that means the next boss to be added will be a new T5 boss, to make each tier have 2 bosses in it. I'm hoping I can extend that to 3 in each tier before 0.5.0, but we'll see![/p][p]I'm going to keep details largely quiet, save for previews of new bosses, because I'd rather this be something you discover over something you're fully aware of going in, I always found it neat to be able to read a new effect and theorise what it's use cases could be as they appear, rather than knowing it all as I go in.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Okay so when's the next update?[/b][/h2][p]0.4.6 with Medusa should drop sometime in the coming week, likely towards the end of it, at latest at the weekend. I mentioned it before, but obviously with the primary focus being getting the roguelike mode clean for 0.5.0, content will take a little bit of a backseat for a while.[/p][p]The good news is, once the roguelike mode's in, that's it, there's no more modes to add, so it's just content, balance and fixes right up to 0.9.9, where 1.0 will see Final Notice go into Early Access on Steam and the itch.io and Steam Demo versions will no longer be updated.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Early Access Plans?[/b][/h1][p]By the time this goes into Early Access, I'm hoping I've got a good wealth of bosses, mechanics, cards, basically enough to call it a complete game - the early access tag is simply there while I'm continuing to refine everything, fix everything up, add new cards and bosses, that kind of thing. Once I feel like Final Notice has fully run it's course and I don't want to continue to add things to it, that's when it'll get taken out of Early Access, and support for the game would cease.[/p][p]Don't worry, that isn't for a while, LOTS to do yet, but by that time the game should be a game with a tonne of bosses, a tonne of unlockables, some cosmetics, a fully functioning roguelike mode - just a neat little game to burn 30 minutes on here and there.[/p][p]Of course, plans change, so don't be surprised if something comes up in the future, but for now, that's my overarching idea. Anyway, I'll wrap this up, cheers to all those enjoying the game, and-[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: New Meta Progression - Final Notice V0.4.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]In today's update there's a whole bunch of new cards for you to go find and theory craft with! I won't share all of them, but I'll share my favourites.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Cards (30 to unlock!)[/h2][p]Now with an added 30 cards, the total number of cards in the game for the player reaches 117. More cards will come over the course of the game, of course, so this isn't the final number. However, cards in general will be taking a bit of a back seat to the new roguelike mode's development, so expect that to be the next chunky update.[/p][p][/p][h3]Personal Favourites[/h3][p]As mentioned, I'll go over a few personal favourites and what the intent behind them was.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/acdfe6e13c16b1fab4084e434af12724aef59570.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Last Resort - [/i]It's intended use is actually two fold, one to utterly nuke your deck and increase mortis, as is probably the more obvious use, but it's secondary use is to guarantee you'll have an empty deck, which has some incredible potency with it's "sister card" so to speak...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/72efdd7fce44c6e77f442925246eb6f40ab99514.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Photocopy - [/i]A card that allows you to shuffle in a very, very exact copy of your hand! With this setup, you can sculpt the perfect hand, detonate your deck for massive mortis increase towards the boss, then draw basically exactly what you want every turn thereforward, just make sure you're copying in another photocopy![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/cb264a0fdf3f45532c91ca780dcd804e42cc1f2c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]R34P - [/i]A favourite for a funny reason, this concept of reapers that used weapons related to the method in which they died to reap souls with (and sometimes divinities!) actually comes from an old short story I wrote some years ago, which ended up being a large part of the reason Final Notice is what Final Notice is today. This one took some work to get in properly, including a whole refactor of end of turn effects, but once I'd got the idea I had to complete it. Check it:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/14c1d772dc93bfbc15b0191a196168244e52feab.gif"][/img]
[i]PEW.[/i][/p][p]Obviously there's an associated noise with it not present in the gif, but this card will draw a bullet trail right at the boss at the end of each turn, increasing it's mortis by 3 each time. However, the R34P firearm will burn your whole hand in compensation. That might seem like a steep cost, and it is, so you'd best be packing some cleanses if you want that free damage...[/p][p]or just duplicate R34P however you can 6 times and sit back and watch 6 bullets get fanned at your opponent every turn change.[/p][p][/p][p]I won't cover any more - just a heads up not all these cards are that easy to unlock, so you might spend some time trying to figure out how. Any questions you know where to find me. All that said, we're full steam ahead on the roguelike mode. If you want more information on that, [url="https://themokujin.itch.io/final-notice/devlog/985974/roguelike-mode-lets-talk-release-date"]head here[/url] where I talk about it in depth.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: Unlockable Cards + The Hardest Boss Yet - Final Notice V04.4.1
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]In today's update, I'll quickly overview some unlockable cards from the bounty bosses, what Maman Brigitte's difficulty entails and, lastly, a little information about upcoming updates.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Feature: Unlockable Cards![/h1][p]So I've talked about this one for a while, but I wanted to add some unlockable cards to Final Notice - currently not [i]all [/i]the ones I wanted to add are in, but all the bosses, except Maman Brigitte, the one in this update, have unlockable "Boss Cards" - which you can tell the difference between because they are A) in more than just "green" colour-wise and B) trimmed with a fancy sort-of-dull-and-grungy gold border.[/p][p]Ideally I'll be keeping these cards [i]pretty much a secret [/i]- so I won't spoil any effects or names, but I will show you the set of them here. They're all [i]pretty damn strong cards [/i]so I'd recommend going to the bounty mode to beat the bosses![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/81ec0a87b8b78fd15aa8d0b13adfc9b31d6b88c2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you've ALREADY beaten the bosses, you only need to open the deckbuilder to receive the new cards.[/p][p][/p][h1]Maman Brigitte[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/4e1891cb99006e1b4bc35236e9e020d0dc29531c.png"][/img][/p][p]Maman Brigitte is the first boss rated at 5/5 for difficulty - she's unforgiving, very, very fond of filling your hand with garbage and very, very fond of making your cards basically unplayable due to mortis costs.[/p][p]She's far easier to beat with the boss cards from her voodoo kin, so I'd recommend tackling them first. She has no special effects other than being immune to stuns, however, so if you manage to crack open some way to OTK her or, even better, completely ignore her even IF she gets a turn, do show it off! I'd love to [strike]nerf[/strike] see it![/p][p][/p][h3]Upcoming![/h3][p]I won't rattle on about this much, plans change all the time after all, but you can expect the following key updates in the future:[/p][p]V0.4.5 - Lots, lots more unlockable cards. You'll start earning cards left and right when you begin, but gradually they'll become neat little "oh, nice!" moments you get from completing hidden challenges. I'd appreciate some feedback if you, the players, would prefer these challenges to remain hidden or not. Personally, I prefer it, but if the majority wants a challenge list, I can do that too. Y'know where to find me best! @friend1252.[/p][p]V0.5.0 - (Ideally) the roguelike mode! This will be in beta, and will likely only contain one run, but this should hopefully be the start of one of the last bit of "planned" content for the game, where you fight sequential bosses of increasing difficulty with a small starter deck, then add passive effects and new cards after each fight. Think Hearthstone's Adventures like Rastakhan's Rumble, but ideally with a lot more jank. (For better or for worse!)[/p][p]That's all I've got for you today, hello to all the new people that've recently picked the game up or check the updates section and, as always-[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: Voodoo Bosses Now Available! - Final Notice V0.4.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]​Today's a big one, I'd class it as a major update usually, but there's some news regarding that in this update, I'll get to it, first let's talk about the brand new inclusions to the boss bounties, and what the mechanics are and the intent behind them.[/p][p][/p][h2]Kalfu, Crossroads[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/14d6edfc13725ee69f3c6a274ddf01c9a0259881.png"][/img][/p][p]Kalfu's mythology paints him as the guy that mans the crossroads in the space between life and death, along with another loa, Papa Legba (who's not in the game... yet?). He's seen as the more darker concept of what that border symbolises than Papa Legba, hence his inclusion here, since I thought it a good balance to how jaunty Samedi and La Croix are going to end up being.[/p][p]His primary mechanic is [i]Curses. [/i]He gives you a card that gives you two options and asks you to pick between bad and bad. It gives you as a player some agency over which bad you take, and sometimes you might even be able to situationally spin the bad into a good! He's the easiest of the loa added, hence the first I'm covering, as he has no special traits other than his use of the new curses cards. He should be relatively easy to beat, but just make sure you play enough cards out to not have him block your draws with the curses.[/p][p][/p][h2]Marinette the Dry Arms[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/88d1a00983ad1a4dbeee47afd0f9b838cb41b150.png"][/img][/p][p]A loa of violence and rage, Marinette is a spirit that wants nothing more than to kill you. Her primary mechanic is a death clock, where you only have 10 turns (9 after her first!) to kill her before she kills you. Her cards primarily hit very hard, but also increase her own mortis by higher than normal values when played, with some having straight downsides. [/p][p]The room features a clock in the back that will help you keep a track of how long you've got to beat her, and if you're lucky she'll even occasionally struggle against her own psyche, giving you a turn off to get some big cards out without having to manage her hard hits.[/p][p][/p][h2]Baron Samedi[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/7b594e8650f34e655b443e52c32f5bee517d7caa.png"][/img][/p][p]A man that surely needs no introduction, Baron Samedi is likely the most recognisable loa that is featured in this patch. Of course, his primary mechanic is very on theme and is a personal favourite, hence the teasers from last week![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/6fdb4dfcb25b8df55c084882262a300365a08364.png"][/img][/p][p]His primary mechanic, [i]brews[/i], are cards that sometimes have downsides, sometimes have upsides and [i]always [/i]increase your mortis costs permanently. Partake a little, but be careful of how many you drink, less you end up off your ass.[/p][p][/p][h2]Baron La Croix[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/08dfd603ba6831659f1e57c591b416c8c1f97d6d.png"][/img]
The hardest of the bunch, Baron La Croix seeks a similar gameplan as Samedi, but is far, far more aggressive with it, repeatedly stacking mortis cost increases that are very difficult to deal with, and massively punishing holding cards in your hand. He's rated as the same difficulty as Agni at 4/5 and will be QUITE DIFFICULT (I hope) to beat reliably. Some playtesters, admittedly, have been able to build meta decks (insane to say) using a lot of theorycrafting and tweaking. I'm aware they exist but[/p][p]It's a singleplayer game. If you can't have fun breaking it, what's the point?[/p][p]Baron La Croix will use some of Samedi's drinks, being so closely affiliated to him, if I had to give any advice it'd be pack a few "prevent mortis cost" cards and make the best of them on use. Good luck![/p][p][/p][h3]Balance Changes (marked with ːsteamhappyː for any player requests!)[/h3][list][*][p]Increased card draw cost on Line of Credit to give it a more real downside. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the number of turns Rotting Curse can remain active for, so you can't stack hundreds of mortis increase per turn on the boss (I'm looking at you, chuck.) [/p][/*][*][p]Tuned the Fire Domain down a little bit, so it provides you an extra card when it rips a card from your hand. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Codex: Index now banishes itself on use so you can't win insanely quickly by just repeatedly pulling it back out of the discard pile. (Didn't do anything else to codexes, just this one that instantly shit on anything in the game.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Corrected some cards not properly counting when they banished cards and by how much, to help banish synergies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the codex counter not syncing properly with how close you are to the wincon. Do note, banishing a codex card [i]without playing it [/i]is [b][i]NOT [/i][/b]the same as playing it. You have to [i]play[/i] all the codex cards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Small Tidbit:[/h3][p]I mentioned at the start I'm changing a bit about how major patches and minor patches work - I've decided it's easier for me (and probably better for everyone) if I just push patches based on what I've done, rather than trying to schedule out larger patches and holding back updates based on if a larger patch is a few days away or not. Might mean more smaller patches, but it'll definitely mean more frequent larger ones. I'll still save 0.X+1.0 (e.g. 0.4.0, 0.5.0) patches for the major, major updates, but the patches between will just be whatever I've done that week.[/p][p]Also, we've had a few donations recently! Thank you a bunch! I mentioned it over on the devlogs for the game on itch.io [url="https://themokujin.itch.io/final-notice/devlog"](check here for the history!)[/url] but I thought I should say thank you here too.[/p][p]As always, hope you'll enjoy these changes and, again, as always...[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: Medals and Developments - Final Notice 0.4.1
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Today's little update revolves around a brand new card mechanic showcased in a brand new card, which will be expanded on in the future. Also, bounty bosses now have a little medal on the far side of the button, to show which ones you've beaten - see if you can get all the medals![/p][p][/p][h1]Passive Card Effects:[/h1][p]To bring a new angle of deckbuilding and gameplay, future cards may contain new passive effects that trigger at certain timings while the card is held in your hand. The first example of this is Office Plant![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/d5b5fdfd9b0d655713f39bd1d6dd587695a2449a.png"][/img][/p][p]Office Plant, as the name suggests, is relatively mundane for a card, but it gives a good showing of what these effects do - these effects are actually mostly used in an upcoming bounty boss for 0.4.5.[/p][p]If you might be wondering what the next few bounty bosses might be, they're actually all themed from the same mythology, to get ready for a thematic roguelike run for 0.5.0. You'll have to check back in a few upcoming devlogs if you want some more clues though!.[/p][p][/p][h2]Medals[/h2][p]Beating bounty bosses previously didn't really have much fanfare, and until unlocks show up, they likely still won't, but I figured it'd be a good idea to at least give you SOMETHING for it in the meantime - so for the moment, enjoy a little medal to determine which bosses you've managed to take down.[/p][p]When the unlock system comes, if you already have the medal, you'll have immediate access to the unlocked cards, so there's some worth getting to it now![/p][p][/p][p]Hope you're all enjoying the game, thanks for playing it and, as always:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: Bounties Update! - V0.4.0
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Quite the long list of patches today so let's get right into it - I did plan to push this update a bit later in the week, but I'd really like some feedback from all of you regarding the bounty bosses and the massive balance change that's a part of this patch. Give it a look, see what's what.[/p][p]As usual, any player feedback will be marked with (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][p][/p][h1]Bounties![/h1][list][*][p]Added the bounties mode! This mode will be updated with new scripted bosses quite regularly. Pre-warning, the bosses are [i]HARD [/i]and will require some deckbuilding to beat. Some tips for beating them are included in the bounties page when you select a boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Currently, three bosses are added, Zeus, Thoth and Agni. Get into the game and have a go! Eventually bosses like this will be used to get unlocks, special cosmetics and ultimately be part of the roguelike mode.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p][i]There's a lot.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Nerfed Exile Dividend to now cost 7 mortis and require 7+ banished cards to draw 2 cards.(ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Quick Shuffle to now draw one less card and cost 15 mortis. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Efficient Filing to now reduce card cost by 2 instead of 3. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Slipstream Filing to now have a 20 requirement instead of 33 but only restore 1 mortis per turn and banish after play.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Ongoing Investigation to now increase boss mortis by 3 instead of 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Stamped Copy to now increase the boss' mortis by 2 instead of 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Final Filing to now only draw one card.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Time Theft to now cost 7 mortis and require 15 to play.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Zero-Tolerance Policy to now burn and fog your whole hand and be banished when played.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Refile and Reissue to now banish after being played but no longer cause a discard. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Carbon Copy to now banish after being played.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Soul Bargain to now give 2 cards next turn instead of 3.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]I'll be monitoring balance pretty closely, after playtesting, I believe this has indeed made the game harder, but admittedly a lot more interactive. Hopefully you feel the same, but always provide any feedback regarding the game balance.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]New Cards![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/ae973e4dd55d5a27b2327351b92bcaaa1bbf5ac1.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Hot Streak - [/i]Boss gains 12 mortis, but burn the leftmost card in your hand.[/p][p][i]Day at the Beach - [/i]You lose 10 mortis, but waterlog the leftmost card in your hand.[/p][p][i]Gravedig - [/i]Add two Dead Draws to your hand. (A card that does nothing!)[/p][p][/p][h2]UI/Tweaks:[/h2][list][*][p]There is now a "concede" button in the top right of every game window, so you don't have to wait to lose unwinnable games.[/p][/*][*][p]The deckbuilder now has the hover-over tooltips for cards on the right when building a deck.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that was causing system lockups rarely when repeatedly leaving the game window or in some cases where the game window was closed externally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hopeful Roll showing the wrong flavour text.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Quite the patch! Tell me what you think of the bosses - I'll be balancing them as we approach 0.5.0.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: Final Notice V0.3.9 - Fixes Before Bounty Mode
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Today's all about fixes and a few features, I'll not waste your time with the flowery stuff, here's the actual contents of today's update. - All PLAYER FEEDBACK based changes will be marked with a "ːsteamhappyː"[/p][p][/p][h1]Fixes:[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with cards that reduce the player's mortis at the start of turn preventing death by boss card effects (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some cards that are over-time effects applying one instance of their effect immediately (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player mortis increase on draw effect from fading after one draw.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some volumes for a more baseline experience, some were a little too loud, some too quiet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where after winning a game, the hover tooltip in the deck select would no longer function. notes.title: New Cards and First Steam Update - V038
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome (I'd usually say Welcome Back!)[/h1][p]The first steam build is live with a new update featuring a few new cards, some visual fixes and a small update to the boss logic.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Cards:[/h2][h3][i][u]Hopeful Roll[/u][/i][/h3][p]Hopeful Roll increases the boss' mortis by a random number between 0-12, but it has a [i]very [/i]small chance to crit, adding 50 mortis to the boss' total. [i]And I do mean small, 1/1000![/i][/p][p]A card for gamblers, truthfully, not much more to it, gives some direct damage potential and if you get [i]lucky lucky [/i]there'll be a nice free win (probably) as a reward.[/p][p][/p][h3][i][u]Line of Credit[/u][/i][/h3][p]Line of Credit lets you draw cards up to max hand size, 6, but increases your mortis by 3 for each card drawn. It's a more flexible Box of Demise, but costs you for using it. An upcoming bounty boss [i]really [/i]likes playing the long game, so I figured this might be a good way to refuel if you're running into a dead end with momentum.[/p][p][/p][h3][i][u]Flash Sale[/u][/i][/h3][p]Flash Sale discards your whole hand, but increases the boss' mortis by 3 per card, and lowers your own mortis by 3 per card, discarded. Meant as a real "oh, shit" button, the Flash Sale card can also be used by decks that love to stack a massive amount of cards in their hand as a potential finisher, or to hand sculpt while stabilising, to help avoid certain boss effects that would otherwise target your hand.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][p]Previously, some of the cards were a liiiiiittle bit illegible if the names were especially long. I'd change some text for the sake of a UI update some time ago, and hadn't ever accounted for the fact it'd change card text too - my bad. This is now mended, so you can stop straining your eyes.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, some bosses, and especially an upcoming bounty boss, had an effect that increased the player's mortis per draw. Welp, that effect happened to carry over games. I've now fixed that, and you won't get bit for an effect you had a game ago.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're completely new to Final Notice, welcome! There's a lot more knowledge and a lot more context over on the itch page [url="https://themokujin.itch.io/final-notice"]here[/url], which I recommend checking out. Otherwise, if you haven't already, wishlist the game! It helps get Final Notice out there.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]
